event_mapping: RETAIL only, validated immutable domain fields; unique positive int64 IDs, valid timezone/calendar/end>start, exact numeric token/Decimal threshold and volume, optional count/volume unknown instead of0. Preserve source order/status; four observed events are ENDED. No administrative fields or whitelist-address arrays exposed.
ui: Points-page entry -> native event list with20/page -> independently fetched detail; header image/date/status/second countdown/id/broker/registration count/total USDC volume, tasks and verified progress, core reward rows, expandable activity rules, campaign rich text, personal registration/performance and top30 volume ranking10/page. Copyable wallet addresses; unknown personal ranks never inferred as30+ or0. Labels are en/zh; published source text stays source text.
rich_content: html package parses bounded source into immutable native document blocks: headings/paragraphs/list items/structured tables/links/images. Script/style/iframe/forms/SVG never execute; HTTPS links only, no credentials/nonstandard ports. Task invalid URLs fail validation instead of substituting another action. Only published Supabase storage public trading-event-content images allowed, raster MIME and5MiB streamed bound, no redirects/credentials or automatic Riverpod retries. Native image failure supports manual retry; url_launcher opens exact configured website target with safe failure. No WebView or embedded executable HTML.
public_ranking: GET rankings/retail-volume?limit=30; response eventId/eventType/rows with rank/address/volume. Require matching event/RETAIL, preserve returned order/ties, validate all bounded rows then cap30,10/page. Never fall back to another venue or recompute server ranks.

personal.basis: Source inspection only, including J callback; no live address-bearing endpoint requested. Synthetic fixtures validate registered, optional stats.ownVolume, optional registrationBlock.reason/conflictingEventName, and optional response eventId/address scope.
personal.behavior: Explicit disclosed wallet read only; no signature/auto address transmission on entry or foreground. Missing registration is unknown; unregistered stats not personal completed progress. ID/address/wallet-kind changes clear personal data; stale/error shown without zero coercion.

registration.authorization: Explicit native confirmation for currently authenticated signing-capable wallet. Connected EOA delegates personal_sign to its own active connection; embedded uses unique existing matching Privy wallet personal_sign with UTF8 hex. No replacement wallet, no chain switching/funds/order request.
registration.preflight: Fresh event and participant GET before signing and again afterward; check rules fingerprint, eligibility/status/end and address/event scope, already registered never re-submits; scope checked between awaits and immediately before POST. Rules fingerprint covers published names/broker/period/rich rules/tasks/rewards; change requires new review.
registration.local_freshness_policy: Signature age must be0..120000ms; this is local defensive policy, not a claimed official server TTL.
registration.result: One POST, no redirect/automatic retry; full request12second timeout. Any transport/non2xx result is unknown, no raw error;2xx is acknowledgement only until personal read verifies registered. Unknown/acknowledged states lock resubmission until explicit participant reconciliation. New screen/app sessions have no persisted registration log, but every new submission preflights registered status; no financial execution implied.
registration.lifecycle: Identity ID/address/wallet-kind/signing capability changes or disposal invalidate pre-send generations; native wallet background jump is allowed and checked on return. Late UI updates discarded; no automatic resubmit or future signed action. Public/personal readers reuse5minute stale/stop/background/disposal guards from points.
